mapper.select:
/* RevertTodoMapper.selectList */
SELECT AA.* , CASE WHEN AA.SAVE_FLAG = '00000000000000000000' THEN '' ELSE '저장' END AS SAVE , CASE WHEN AA.SAVE_CHG_DTM = '00000000000000000000' THEN '' ELSE 'start' END AS STARTED , E.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM , F.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_PRCSNM , G.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATVTNM , H.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , I.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , J.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_NM , CASE WHEN AA.BL IS NULL OR AA.IVOC IS NULL THEN 'NO_BLIV' ELSE 'BLIV' END AS BLIV FROM ( SELECT '3' AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD
, (-- 저장 플래그 SELECT NVL(MAX(LST_DB_CHG_DTM),'00000000000000000000') FROM ( SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD005TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_TPY_SAVE_YN = 'Y' AND AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = '3' ) ) AS SAVE_FLAG
, (--임시저장최종일시 SELECT NVL(MAX(LST_DB_CHG_DTM),'00000000000000000000') FROM( SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD005TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_TPY_SAVE_YN = 'Y' AND AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = '3'
UNION ALL
SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND INPT_MST_SRNO IN (SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = '3' AND AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = '51') ) ) AS SAVE_CHG_DTM , A.AI_INPT_QLAS_PROS_CD , A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD , NVL(E.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD, I.TDOC_RCP_CUCD) AS FC_CUNM , NVL(E.XPBY_COL_AM,I.TDOC_RCP_AM) AS AI_INPT_BUY_AM , NVL(E.CUS_KORL_NM,I.CUS_KORL_NM) AS AI_INPT_CUS_NM , NVL(E.CSNO, I.CSNO) AS AI_INPT_CSNO , A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT , A.ACTL_FX_REFNO , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO , A.AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO ,( SELECT MAX(FILT_DTCT_NO) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO FROM CSPD007TL WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO , (SELECT MAX(X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY H.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC) AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD008TH H , CSPD112TI X WHERE H.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = '120' AND H.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = '3' AND X.AI_INPT_GRP_CD(+) = '300' AND X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD(+) = H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD ) AS WRR_INFO , A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS MST_CHG_DTM ,( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD002TG WHERE IMEX_HIS_CD = '01' AND INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS BL ,( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD002TG WHERE IMEX_HIS_CD = '02' AND INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS IVOC
ORDER BY SAVE
ORDER BY SAVE DESC
ORDER BY E.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY E.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY AA.AI_INPT_CSNO
ORDER BY AA.AI_INPT_CSNO DESC
ORDER BY AA.ACTL_FX_REFNO
ORDER BY AA.ACTL_FX_REFNO DESC
ORDER BY F.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY F.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY G.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY G.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY AA.FC_CUNM
ORDER BY AA.FC_CUNM DESC
ORDER BY AA.AI_INPT_BUY_AM
ORDER BY AA.AI_INPT_BUY_AM DESC
ORDER BY AA.AI_INPT_CUS_NM
ORDER BY AA.AI_INPT_CUS_NM DESC
ORDER BY H.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM
ORDER BY H.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM DESC
ORDER BY I.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM
ORDER BY I.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM DESC
ORDER BY J.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM
ORDER BY J.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM DESC
ORDER BY AA.INPT_RCP_DT
ORDER BY AA.INPT_RCP_DT DESC
ORDER BY AA.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD
ORDER BY AA.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD DESC
ORDER BY WRR_INFO
ORDER BY WRR_INFO DESC
ORDER BY AA.SAVE_CHG_DTM DESC , AA.MST_CHG_DTM
